pros: Eight water stations, two fruit stations and two sponge stations on the 2025 half-marathon course
Every entrant insured, with hospital cover up to Rp2.5 million for sports injuries
A 3.5-hour half-marathon cut-off and a finisher jacket for half-marathon finishers
A runner described the 2025 route as relatively flat, with strict marshalling and no traffic trouble
cons: Race packs are collected in central Jakarta, not at the BSD start, with no race-day collection in 2026
Humid at the start: 26°C with a 24°C dew point at 5am in 2025
Flag-off times are published only in the race guide shortly before the race
name: Astra Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Astra Half Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 29 November 2026 at Astra Biz Center in BSD, Tangerang, over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon.
ai_summary: Astra Half Marathon 2026 takes place on Sunday 29 November 2026, based at Astra Biz Center in BSD, Tangerang. It offers 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, and is staged by the Astra group as part of its run-up to the company's seventieth anniversary, under the theme "Berkarya dan Tumbuh Bersama Indonesia".

faqs.question: When is Astra Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Sunday 29 November 2026, in BSD, Tangerang, starting from Astra Biz Center. Indonesian road races start before dawn to avoid the heat, so expect a very early flag-off and plan transport to the start the night before rather than on the morning.

faqs.question: What distances does Astra Half Marathon 2026 offer?
faqs.answer: Three: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The half marathon is the headline distance, and the shorter races are aimed at newer runners and those who want a faster morning. Entry fees and cut-off times are set by the organiser, so check the official registration page before entering.
